content.user_title: Generate Complete Favicons for Web Projects
content.value_statement: Web projects need several favicon sizes, a manifest, and framework-specific metadata. This skill generates the assets and updates supported project files.
actual_capabilities: Checks source paths and accepts PNG, JPG, JPEG, SVG, WEBP, and GIF extensions.
Detects common frameworks and selects their usual static asset directory.
Generates ICO and PNG favicon files in five standard size targets.
Copies an SVG source as favicon.svg when applicable.
Creates or updates site.webmanifest while preserving selected existing display settings.
Updates favicon metadata for Rails, Next.js, and static HTML projects.
limitations: ImageMagick version 7 or newer must already be installed.
Format checks use file extensions, while ImageMagick determines whether image contents are valid.
Automatic metadata updates cover Rails, Next.js, and static HTML only.
Ambiguous project structures require confirmation, and existing generated filenames may be replaced.

use_cases.title: Launch a New Website
use_cases.description: Generate browser, mobile, and manifest icons from one approved brand image.

use_cases.title: Standardize Client Branding
use_cases.description: Replace incomplete favicon assets and connect consistent metadata across a supported project.

use_cases.title: Modernize Application Icons
use_cases.description: Add current favicon sizes and a web manifest to an existing application.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Basic Favicons
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate the complete favicon set from assets/logo.png and update this project.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner has one source logo in a standard web project.

prompt_templates.title: Use an SVG Source
prompt_templates.prompt: Create favicons from brand/icon.svg, preserve the SVG version, and update the detected layout metadata.
prompt_templates.scenario: A project needs raster icons plus a scalable browser icon.

prompt_templates.title: Confirm Asset Placement
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate favicons from design/mark.webp, but ask before writing when multiple static asset directories are plausible.
prompt_templates.scenario: A repository contains several applications or unclear asset locations.

prompt_templates.title: Preserve Existing Manifest Settings
prompt_templates.prompt: Regenerate favicons from assets/new-brand.png, preserve existing manifest colors and display mode, then report every replaced file.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced update must retain established progressive web application settings.

output_examples.input: Generate favicons from assets/logo.png for this Next.js application.
output: Detected Next.js with public as the static asset directory.
Generated the ICO, PNG, Apple touch, and manifest icon files.
Updated the layout metadata and site web manifest.

output_examples.input: Create favicons from brand/icon.svg for this Rails project.
output: Detected Rails with public as the static asset directory.
Generated raster favicon assets and copied the SVG source.
Updated the application layout and preserved existing manifest display settings.

output_examples.input: Generate favicons, but the repository has two possible web roots.
output_examples.output: The project structure is ambiguous. Choose the target static asset directory before generation continues.

best_practices: Use a square, high-resolution source image with enough padding around the mark.
Review existing favicon files and manifest settings before generation.
Verify generated icons in browsers and installed application views.
anti_patterns: Do not use a low-resolution source that becomes blurred at larger sizes.
Do not guess the static directory when multiple application roots exist.
Do not discard existing manifest colors or display settings without review.

faq.question: Which source image formats are supported?
faq.answer: The workflow accepts PNG, JPG, JPEG, SVG, WEBP, and GIF files.

faq.question: Does this skill require external software?
faq.answer: Yes. ImageMagick version 7 or newer must be available before generation begins.

faq.question: Which favicon files are generated?
faq.answer: It creates a multi-resolution ICO, a 96-pixel PNG, an Apple touch icon, and two web application icons.

faq.question: Will it preserve my existing web manifest?
faq.answer: It preserves existing theme color, background color, and display values while updating names and icons.

faq.question: Which frameworks receive automatic metadata updates?
faq.answer: Rails, Next.js, and static HTML projects receive direct layout or document updates.

faq.question: What happens when the project type is unclear?
faq.answer: The skill asks for the target asset directory or provides manual HTML guidance when no project is detected.
